استئم (form X)
# اُسْتُئِمَّ (ustuʔimma) /us.tu.ʔim.ma/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
# اِسْتَئِمَّ (istaʔimma) /is.ta.ʔim.ma/: second-person masculine singular imperative of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
# اِسْتَئِمِّ (istaʔimmi) /is.ta.ʔim.mi/: second-person masculine singular imperative of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
